t: St Sepulchre is the name of an ancient parish, not a single building. Its southern part lay inside the City of London and its northern part outside it. Today that ground sits within Smithfield, Farringdon and Clerkenwell. The parish has a couple of people attached to it. Thomas Davies, a bookseller who became lord mayor of London, was buried here, and he lived from 1632 to 1680. Mary Robison, a member of the Society of Friends who lived from 1623 to 1707, died here.
